Do you think Zeus enjoyed it? 🛁🤎🐾 Adoptable through @Weird Rescue Zeus is a 3-year-old, high-energy Doberman with the biggest heart and the goofiest personality. He’s a total sweetheart with a heart of gold. He still has plenty of playful puppy energy and gets the zoomies often, but his favorite thing in the world? Being with his people. 🥰 Whether he’s carrying his favorite blanket from room to room, following you around the house, or soaking up every ounce of attention he can get, this boy is always smiling. Zeus is very smart and loves to work. He’s fully obedience trained, attends Rally classes, and truly shines with structure and purpose. Highly food motivated, he’s eager to learn, loves to please, and is an absolute dream for anyone who enjoys training dogs. He has been obedience trained in both English and French.  He gets along wonderfully with all of our dogs, and absolutely loves kids. Because of his play style, he does best with dogs 30 pounds and up. He would thrive with an adopter who has working-breed experience and is excited to continue giving him structure, training, and plenty of adventures. He is crate trained, X-pen trained, house trained, neutered, vaccinated, and more than ready to find his forever family. 💛 Just a few months ago, Zeus was sitting in a shelter after his family moved away. Three days later, he was scheduled to be euthanized. Thankfully, the incredible team at Weird Rescue saw what everyone who meets him sees, a goofy, loving dog who simply needed someone to believe in him. Watching Zeus embrace his second chance has been one of the greatest privileges, and we know his perfect family is out there. If you think that could be you, please apply through Weird Rescue. 🤎 #asmr #doberman #dogbath

How to make Green Apple Ice Cream Apple 🍏: Peel, core, and cut 5 Granny Smith apples into small chunks. Add the apples, 30 g water, 80 g sugar, and 10 g lemon juice to a saucepan. Cook over medium heat until the apples are completely soft, then blend until smooth. Transfer the apple puree to a shallow container. Stir in the juice of 1 lemon and ¼ cup of sugar, then freeze overnight until completely solid. (The first addition of 10g lemon juice prevents the apples from browning, while the second addition of one lemon juice is for adding a tangy flavor.) The next day, whip 200 g heavy cream, 60 g sweetened condensed milk, and 1 tsp vanilla extract until stiff peaks form. Use a fork to scrape the frozen apple puree into fine flakes. Add the flakes to the whipped cream and gently mix until evenly combined. Transfer the mixture to an airtight container and freeze overnight before serving. ❤ #tiktokrecipecontest #icecream #dessert #fruit #homecooking

🐹 Guinea pigs are a HUGE commitment and definitely aren’t the “easy starter pet” they’re often thought to be. They need spacious housing, daily spot cleaning, a thorough weekly clean, unlimited fresh hay, a balanced diet, enrichment, companionship and regular health checks. Caring for guinea pigs is a daily responsibility that can last 5–8 years (sometimes up to 10!) Sadly, rescue centres are full of guinea pigs looking for loving homes, with owners surrendering them for many different reasons, including underestimating the time, cost and commitment involved. Before bringing guinea pigs home for your child, ask yourself one question: If they lose interest, are you prepared to take over their care for the rest of their lives? Every guinea pig deserves a lifetime of love, care and commitment 💖 #vetnurseadvice #guineapigs #parents #peteducation #guineapigcare

낫 킴 안(Nhat Kim Anh) 대표가 운영하는 로라 커피(Laura Coffee)는 고객에게 고품질 제품, 풍부한 맛, 그리고 완벽한 커피 경험을 선사하고자 하는 열망을 바탕으로 탄생한 커피 브랜드입니다. 로라 커피는 원두 선정부터 로스팅, 포장에 이르기까지 모든 과정에 심혈을 기울여 커피 본연의 향과 깊은 풍미를 그대로 보존하는 데 집중합니다. 로라 커피 한 잔은 단순한 음료를 넘어, 생산 과정의 모든 단계에서 쏟는 정성과 세심함, 그리고 책임감을 담아 고객에게 잊지 못할 경험을 선사합니다. 커피는 오랫동안 베트남 사람들의 삶에서 빼놓을 수 없는 부분이었습니다. 아침에 마시는 커피 한 잔은 하루를 활기찬 에너지로 시작하게 해주고, 오후에 마시는 커피는 공부와 업무로 지친 몸에 휴식을 더해줍니다. 커피는 단순한 음료를 넘어 가족, 친구, 동료들과 만나고, 이야기를 나누고, 소통하는 매개체이기도 합니다. 로라 커피는 이러한 가치를 바탕으로 다양한 고객층의 니즈를 충족하는 고품질 제품을 제공하고, 베트남 커피 문화를 널리 알리는 데 기여하고자 끊임없이 노력하고 있습니다. 낫 킴 안 대표가 운영하는 로라 커피는 제품 품질에 집중하는 것 외에도 헌신과 끊임없는 개선을 통해 고객과의 신뢰를 구축하는 데 주력하고 있습니다. 로라 커피는 항상 고객의 피드백에 귀 기울여 제품을 개선하고 품질을 향상시키며 더 나은 고객 경험을 제공하기 위해 노력합니다. 지속 가능한 발전을 지향하는 로라 커피는 많은 사람들에게 사랑받고 선택받는 브랜드가 되기를 열망합니다. 모든 제품에는 정성과 열정, 그리고 삶에 긍정적인 가치를 전하고자 하는 마음이 담겨 있습니다. 앞으로도 로라 커피는 국내외 더 많은 고객에게 베트남 커피의 풍미를 선사하고 시장에서 브랜드의 품질과 명성을 더욱 공고히 하며 지속적인 발전을 거듭해 나갈 것입니다.#xuhuong #2011 #fyp

⚠️ Scanned on the Exposr app⚠️ Starbucks employees are going viral for exposing a new ingredient being added to blended drinks — and it's making them sick. This month, Starbucks rolled out a silica-based blending powder across locations nationwide. Silicon dioxide — used in concrete and glass manufacturing — is now in your Refresher. Baristas say the powder becomes airborne the second it's scooped. Multiple employees have posted videos describing coughing fits, sore throats, and headaches that only started after the powder was introduced. The union representing 12,000 Starbucks workers publicly called it out: "Breathing in silica powder can be dangerous." Prolonged silica inhalation is linked to silicosis — an irreversible lung disease with no cure. The rest of the powder includes maltodextrin, gum arabic, xanthan gum, and undisclosed "natural flavour." None of it is listed on the menu. None of it is disclosed to customers. The powder exists for one reason — to keep your blended drink from separating after it's made. A texture fix. That's it. Starbucks chose a lung-damaging industrial compound over a drink that separates slightly faster. Their workers are reporting symptoms on every shift. The company hasn't publicly addressed a single complaint. Scanned on the Exposr app

We once discussed veterinary medicine from the perspective of how humans came to the idea of helping other living creatures while spending their own time and resources on it. Strictly speaking, this mostly applies to pets, because in the industrial world veterinarians often work with farm animals. Today I want you to think about how incredibly complex this science really is. A veterinarian has to understand the anatomy and physiology of dozens of different species in order to help them. From a tiny aquarium fish to a massive python, any creature may need care, and it is honestly impressive how veterinarians manage to keep all of this knowledge in their minds while making decisions that can determine the fate of their patients. Veterinarians save tens of thousands of beloved pets and prevent epidemics among farm animals, which in many ways also means protecting human populations. Thank you, veterinarians. #Veterinarian #Medicine #Animals #edit #Pets
